entities.name: Human IAPP
observations: The 89-residue query sequence exactly matches reviewed human islet amyloid polypeptide (UniProt P10997).
IAPP is a secreted glucoregulatory peptide hormone and receptor ligand acting through CALCR-RAMP amylin receptor complexes.
The precursor contains an N-terminal hydrophobic signal-peptide-like segment; sequence analysis predicts a basic protein with pI 9.83 and molecular mass about 9.81 kDa before processing.
Pfam identifies the Calc_CGRP_IAPP family domain at residues 27–73.
IAPP can form homodimers and interacts with insulin and insulin-degrading enzyme; insulin interaction can inhibit fibril formation.
